collection_purpose: Pre-outcome literature and proxy-feasibility audit only
body_retention_policy: Hash-only metadata. No record-level primary proxy export was accessible, so there are no eligible proxy rows or licensed provider bytes to cache. HTTP response hashes and sizes identify the exact responses examined without republishing third-party pages.

sources.title: How private credit investment is filling a funding gap in Latin America
sources.institutional_claim_supported: Latin America private credit differs from the US LBO model and is framed around a USD650 billion annual development-financing gap; the article reports less than 1% private-credit penetration and cites USD800 million of Latin America-focused fundraising in 2025.
sources.research_role: 2026 institutional motivation only; prohibited from historical backfill

sources.title: Understanding the Growth of Private Markets: Structural Shifts in the Investment Industry
sources.publisher: CFA Institute Research and Policy Center
sources.institutional_claim_supported: Private markets alter capital formation and risk transmission while disclosure opacity and bank-nonbank linkages limit transparent measurement.
sources.research_role: institutional motivation and measurement caveat; not a LatAm historical exposure series

sources.title: Faced with Financing for Development Challenges, Latin American and Caribbean Countries Need to Strengthen their Capacities to Mobilize Resources and Forge Renewed Cooperation Mechanisms
sources.publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean
sources.institutional_claim_supported: ECLAC states that Latin America and the Caribbean face an approximately USD650 billion annual development-financing gap.
sources.research_role: primary institutional source for the funding-gap magnitude; not a private-credit supply series

sources.title: DOWNLOAD: Fundraising hits new high in 2025
sources.institutional_claim_supported: The public landing establishes the existence of a fundraising report and database surface, but withholds the record-level content required for the preregistered proxy.

sources.title: Transactions archive
sources.publication_date: rolling archive; individual entries dated 2024-08 through 2026-07 on the inspected page
sources.institutional_claim_supported: One manager publicly archives dated Latin America private-credit transactions.
sources.research_role: proof that isolated official releases exist

sources.title: Darby International Capital Announces the Final Close of its 4th Fund
sources.institutional_claim_supported: A dated official final-close announcement exists for a USD363 million Latin America private-credit fund.
sources.research_role: one qualifying-looking example, insufficient to establish a complete zero-filled monthly series

sources.title: Private Credit, Balance Sheets and Financial Stability
sources.institutional_claim_supported: Comprehensive private-credit fund and asset analysis relies on licensed MSCI Private Capital Universe data; public disclosures do not reproduce that coverage.
sources.research_role: primary academic evidence on private-credit measurement and transmission limits

sources.title: The Secular Decline of Bank Balance Sheet Lending
sources.institutional_claim_supported: Credit intermediation has shifted away from bank balance sheets toward securities and nonbank channels, motivating a supply-transmission question without identifying a LatAm point-in-time proxy.

sources.title: A Simple Approximate Long-Memory Model of Realized Volatility
sources.publisher: Oxford University Press, Journal of Financial Econometrics
sources.author: Fulvio Corsi
sources.institutional_claim_supported: The HAR-RV specification is the preregistered volatility-model benchmark family; the publisher page was access-controlled during this audit.

proxy_feasibility_readback.exact_failure_reason: The preregistered Private Debt Investor record-level enumeration/export was not accessible: the inspected public response required sign-in/account creation and exposed neither provider record IDs nor historical version/as-of timestamps. Public sponsor pages supplied isolated examples, not a complete regional fund universe. Therefore missing search hits cannot be coded as zero-event months, event-count thresholds cannot be evaluated, and no point-in-time monthly proxy can be constructed without selection/backfill bias.
